meal.title: Reading input with scanf
meal.objective: Read an integer, a character, and a string from the user using scanf

voice.script: What if the computer could ask you for a number? How do you get the user to type a value? In C you use a function called scanf, which listens for what you type and stores it inside a variable. The ampersand symbol before a variable tells scanf where in memory to put the data. First, we ask for an integer, then a single character, and finally a short word. On screen you see a short program using scanf. When you run it, the program pauses, you type a number, a letter, and a word, then it prints them back so you can see they were captured. This shows how input and output work together.
